composition_subtypes.role: Sort voters by m_i to process highest requirements first
Min-heap to select cheapest bribe among current m_i group

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort by m_i, iterate from high m_i; use min-heap to bribe cheapest from current m_i when needed to meet requirement deficit.
payload.rationale: Greedy sorting sets processing order to satisfy high m_i first; heap efficiently picks min cost to bridge gaps.
